events.summary: The causal-novelty branch closed after prior art and execution constraints blocked a defensible discovery.
A third paid comparable advanced the Municipal CAE Owner Pack to N6 VALIDATING.
Database index selection became the first execution prospect but remains unadmitted pending a reproducible benchmark.
Revenue N6 demand evidence and Asset A6 guided intake form a testable CAE intake-to-owner-pack crossover; no integrated result exists yet.
Official procurement routes were recovered, but acceptance, invoice and payment evidence remain incomplete.
AgnosticEngine fitness was corrected to 0.34 after request-level reliability evidence; no pilot before repair.
A primary award payload confirmed buyer, supplier, value and planned execution, while acceptance and payment remain unverified.
Evolution Forge moved to BLOCKED because the selected public benchmark cannot run on the available execution surface; no candidate claim was made.
A national public buyer budgeted a larger integrated service, but conflicting status means category-scale intent only, not realized willingness to pay.
A national framework validated the three-phase municipal workflow and fixed-plus-variable economics; the capturable route shifted to tooling or subcontracting for eventual prime suppliers.
The national framework progressed from bidding to evaluation; no awardee or awarded economics are public, so N6 and the supplier-channel gate remain unchanged.
The zero-cost model router removes fixed-slug retirement risk, but a fresh root HTTP 500 confirms the independent production reliability defect remains.
